channels.name: Patents
channels.lead_time: Filing precedes product by years; US applications are generally published about 18 months after filing (35 U.S.C. 122(b), unverified here).
channels.coverage: Strong for hardware, biotech, deep tech; weak for software and services.
channels.biases: Large firms file more; filing is not invention quality; classification drift.
channels.deception_risks: Defensive or strategic filings and shell assignees.
channels.licensing: Open bulk data from patent offices; commercial aggregators vary.
channels.point_in_time: Use publication or grant date as known_at, not filing date.

channels.name: Scientific publications and preprints
channels.coverage: Strong in science and engineering; uneven by language and region.
channels.biases: Citation lag; prestige bias; author-name ambiguity.
channels.licensing: Open scholarly graphs are open; full text varies.

channels.name: Open-source activity
channels.deception_risks: Fake stars, inflated forks, abandoned-but-active repos.
channels.point_in_time: Event timestamps are good; account metadata is not PIT.

channels.name: Hiring and labour data
channels.lead_time: Weeks to months ahead of growth or contraction.
channels.coverage: Strong for companies that post publicly; weak for small or non-English markets.
channels.biases: Posting is not hiring; duplicates; platform panel bias.
channels.deception_risks: Ghost postings and mass posting for appearance.
channels.point_in_time: Posting date is observable; vendors often restate history.

channels.name: Grants and procurement
channels.coverage: Strong for government-facing technology in jurisdictions with open award data.
channels.biases: Only covers government-funded work; award is not delivery.
channels.deception_risks: Pass-through and prime/sub obscuring the performer.
channels.licensing: Open government data in many countries.
channels.point_in_time: Award date is public; amendments restate values.

channels.name: Regulatory and registry filings
channels.lead_time: Coincident with or after events; the main verifiable record.
channels.coverage: Strong for registered companies; thin for exempt, offshore, or unfiled activity.
channels.licensing: Public registries; terms vary by jurisdiction.
channels.point_in_time: Use filed_time; amendments are new facts.

channels.name: Trade and customs
channels.lead_time: Weeks to months ahead of reported revenue for hardware.
channels.coverage: Goods only; coverage depends on the country's disclosure.
channels.biases: Aggregation hides firms; classification codes are coarse.
channels.licensing: Commercial and public sources; licence-gated in many countries.

channels.name: Web and app telemetry
channels.coverage: Consumer products with web or app presence.
channels.biases: Panel composition; bot traffic; modelled estimates.

channels.name: Narrative and news
channels.lead_time: Coincident; sentiment can lead or lag.
channels.biases: Press-release amplification; language and region skew.
channels.licensing: Open event data and licensed news; terms vary.
channels.point_in_time: Publication timestamps are usable; republished stories are not new.

channels.name: Satellite and geospatial
channels.biases: Resolution, cloud cover, and cost limit coverage.
channels.point_in_time: Acquisition date is exact; tasking is selective.
